name: orpheus-3b
licenseNote: COMMERCIAL-OK. Apache-2.0 — commercial serving and redistribution both clear with no separate license.

weights.note: Llama-3-based Speech-LLM, 3B. Capture per-shard SHA-256 from model.safetensors.index.json at the pinned revision at build.

resources.recommendedGpu: 1x GPU (~12-16GB) for the 3B. Also released in 1B / 400M / 150M sizes for lighter deployments — add as separate manifests if needed.

notes: Orpheus (Canopy AI), Apache-2.0, Llama-based Speech-LLM. The commercial-safe EXPRESSIVE/emotional pick: guided emotion via tags, zero-shot cloning, ~200ms streaming (->~100ms with input streaming). Because it is Llama-architecture it fits an LLM-style serving stack (vLLM/SGLang) cleanly. Multilingual research variants exist (zh/hi/ko/es) — verify their license separately, the base English 3B is the Apache one. 4 sizes available (150M-3B) — pick per hardware.
